featured_reviews.name: Adv Surabhi Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Azorte at Viviana Mall with some excitement, hoping to discover a new go-to spot for trendy clothing. The store definitely looks appealing from the outside. It has that modern, upscale vibe that draws you in with high hopes. But once inside, the experience felt a bit underwhelming.

The clothing collection was just okay. There were a couple of linen shirts that caught my eye, and I genuinely liked them. But the price tag of around ₹2999 for each shirt felt way too steep for the quality and feel of the fabric. It wasn’t bad, just not worth that price. You expect a bit more variety or something that really stands out if you’re going to spend that much on a single piece.

What really stood out was how limited the product range was. There weren’t many options to explore, which was a bit of a letdown. It felt like the store had more open space than clothes. For someone who loves browsing and mixing styles before deciding, there just wasn’t much to choose from.

The staff was courteous and left us to explore, which I appreciated. But overall, the shopping experience didn’t quite match the prices they were charging. It might work for someone who’s into minimal and premium-looking pieces, but if you’re looking for value or variety, this might not be your first choice.
